review.shorterRoute: Reuse the native primitive-generator kernel, finite primitive columns, actual Hecke cosets, integral unipotent formulas and normalizer H1 maps. The older Gamma0 formula uses level-multiple loops and cannot supply the needed faithful torsion boundary. Primitive widths, actual fixed/prime orbits and their integral conjugations give the original two-term formula with the full homogeneous action. Existing residue-unit normalizer labels then give the diamond comparison on the same finite carrier. No modular-symbol replacement, arbitrary boundary extension, or cancellation of a nonunit cusp width is used.
assumptionsToDischarge: The literal primitive boundary on native finite columns has exactly the original parabolic H1 kernel when two is invertible.
The actual native homogeneous Gamma1 Hecke action intertwines the explicit two-term finite boundary operators.
The same boundary intertwines actual original normalizer diamonds with their homogeneous coefficient action retained.
review.remaining: The 22-module scope establishes the faithful boundary comparisons only. Subsequent scratch proofs of finite-unit actions, cyclotomic boundary Galois action, Frobenius quadratic and prescribed arithmetic descent are compiled but not covered by this receipt. Joint prime/diamond original-character specialization, the combined arithmetic realization, exceptional primes, characteristic-zero association, automorphy and literal higher symmetric-power continuation remain required. DUB-17--20 OPEN; acceptance stays 16/20 with all original criteria unchanged.
review.boundary: Scratch audit only; production promotion and assembled verification pending.
